name: ui-batch
goal: UI·화면 에셋 — 타이틀 배경, 로고 심볼, 사장님 얼굴 2종(평가서·잔소리용), 목숨 아이콘. 골든 톤 앵커. 글자는 절대 이미지에 넣지 않음(코드 렌더).
style: bold clean dark outlines, vibrant high-saturation colors, energetic comic cartoon sticker style, playful chunky proportions, flat cel shading with one simple gloss highlight
common: no text, no watermark, no logo lettering, no letters of any alphabet, 1024x1024 PNG with alpha unless stated otherwise, single centered subject, transparent background

items.label: 타이틀 배경
items.subject: a lively collage-style scene of empty korean part-time job stations (sushi counter, gimbap kitchen, cafe bar, convenience store, delivery boxes) arranged around a bright empty center area
items.common: portrait 1024x1536 full-frame scene (no transparency), the CENTER 50% must be simple and low-contrast to hold a logo and a button rendered by code, no text, no people, warm energetic lighting

items.label: 로고 심볼(왕관)
items.subject: a chunky golden king's crown with a tiny sweat drop, mascot-like, worn slightly tilted — symbol for a part-time-job king

items.label: 사장님 얼굴(만족)
items.subject: the face and shoulders of a middle-aged korean shop owner character with an apron, satisfied proud smile with arms crossed, comic mascot style

items.label: 사장님 얼굴(잔소리)
items.subject: the face and shoulders of the same middle-aged korean shop owner character with an apron, comically annoyed scolding expression with a popped vein, comic mascot style

items.label: 목숨 아이콘(명찰)
items.subject: a small employee name badge clip pin with a heart symbol on it, game life icon
